name: read_stm_MC
title: Read an MC compressed-column sparse matrix. The reader returns the stored matrix.

origin.description: Read an MC compressed-column sparse matrix. The reader returns the stored matrix.
origin.details: Read an MC compressed-column sparse matrix. The reader returns the stored matrix.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(slam))

f <- tempfile()
writeLines("2 2 3", paste0(f, "_dim"))
writeLines(c("0", "1", "0"), paste0(f, "_row_ccs"))
writeLines(c("0", "2", "3"), paste0(f, "_col_ccs"))
writeLines(c("1.5", "3", "2"), paste0(f, "_tfn_nz"))
print(as.matrix(read_stm_MC(f)))

translation.description: Read an MC compressed-column sparse matrix. The reader returns the stored matrix.
translation.details: Read an MC compressed-column sparse matrix. The reader returns the stored matrix.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from slam import read_stm_MC
from slam._arrays import as_matrix
folder = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
(folder / "mc_dim").write_text("2 2 3\n")
(folder / "mc_row_ccs").write_text("0\n1\n0\n")
(folder / "mc_col_ccs").write_text("0\n2\n3\n")
(folder / "mc_tfn_nz").write_text("1.5\n3\n2\n")
print(as_matrix(read_stm_MC(folder / "mc")))
